source.review: EY reviewed consolidated 6M2026 statement; physical page 63 note 44.1 includes comparative FY2025

issuerEvidence.entity: Page 14 identifies VIB and 100%-owned VIBAMC, an asset/debt management subsidiary; no consumer-finance subsidiary identified.
issuerEvidence.classification: Pages 17-18 notes 4.3-4.5 apply TT31/2024 and Decree86 classifications to a broader debt population than customer loans.
issuerEvidence.customerLoans: Page36 note9 reports gross customer loans and refers to note44.1 for quality.
issuerEvidence.table: Page63 separately discloses customer loans, purchased debt, investment securities and interbank exposures, with a total classified asset column.
issuerEvidence.exclusions: Page63 excludes equity, SBV bills, government bonds and listed corporate bonds from securities population; excludes current interbank deposits.

assessment: The independently disclosed broad totals reproduce both rounded headlines. This is an exploratory population comparison, not an issuer-confirmed headline formula. No backward-solved denominator or residual is used. Headline wording does not explicitly identify its denominator or establish separate bank-only versus consolidated scope.

regulatoryLead.status: Search-index discovery only; direct original returned 403; no retained authoritative current legal text admitted.
regulatoryLead.hypothesis: TT31 regulatory NPL may use all classified debt rather than customer loans. Applicability/current amendments and explicit issuer linkage remain unqualified.

alternativesReviewed: Securities, purchased debt and interbank denominator
requiredProof: Issuer/regulator confirmation explicitly tying the 2.10% and 2.16% headline to a defined denominator and perimeter, or qualified correction/restatement. A numeric fit alone is insufficient.
unit: VND million for all disclosed balances; ratios expressed as percent. Existing canonical receipt balances are VND, checked with exact 1,000,000 conversion.

hypothesisFindings.finding: Statement is consolidated. Note 44.1 uses bank wording without an explicit alternative headline perimeter; no bank-only adjustment qualified.
Note 1 identifies only VIBAMC. No issuer bridge attributes the ratio difference to subsidiary exclusions.

hypothesisFindings.hypothesis: VAMC, debt sold/transferred, written off, restructured or margin populations
hypothesisFindings.finding: No explicit issuer bridge from these categories to the headline numerator or denominator was established in inspected notes. No subtraction, reallocation or normalized credit adjustment admitted.

Notes 4.3-4.5 and 44.1 establish a broader classified asset table; its explicit total numerically matches headline rounding. The headline formula and applicable legal-definition linkage remain unqualified.
